About.headline: A visual storyteller, not a drone guy.

bio.paragraph1: Esteban is a South Florida-based visual storyteller. He shoots and edits across formats — drone, camera, and post — so a project stays in one pair of hands from the first frame to the final cut.
bio.paragraph2: He works in English and Spanish, on set and in the edit. That bilingual range matters in South Florida, where the best shoots usually move between languages without breaking the flow.
bio.paragraph3: The throughline across every project — brand films, weddings, real estate, portraits, commercial — is the same: the work has to feel like a film, not a deliverable.

brandStatement.statement: We make things feel like a film.
brandStatement.support: One studio for capture and post — calm, cinematic, and built around your story. No corporate jargon, no flashy gimmicks, no superlatives we can't back up with the work.

equipment.headline: The gear behind the work.
equipment.lede: A pro hybrid setup tuned for both stills and motion, paired with cinema-grade drones and a calibrated post-production suite. The kit serves the story — it isn't the point.
equipment.footnote: Kit list updated as Esteban's gear evolves. Specific bodies, glass, and drones swap based on the shoot's requirements.
